$comment: v1 — frozen per docs/14-implementation-plan-ph5.md Step 2 (A3). Mirrors pkg/detectors.Finding exactly; do not change field names/types/required-ness without bumping $id and updating every MCP client. severity and confidence are always detector-set — never agent-writable (doc90's Decision 4, corrected: the agent's own success-probability estimate lives on a PlanTree leaf, pkg/agenttask, not here).
title: Finding

type.description: The detector family that produced this finding. Open set — new detectors add new values over time, so this is not a closed enum. Known values as of v1: "idor", "misconfig", "authbypass", "ssrf", "businesslogic".

severity.description: Deterministic, detector-set impact rating. Never agent-writable.

confidence.description: Deterministic, detector-set evidence quality: "high" for cross-account baseline evidence, "low" for a single-account heuristic needing manual triage. Never agent-writable, and distinct from the agent-set success-probability Confidence band on a PlanTree leaf (pkg/agenttask) — that field never touches a Finding.

target.description: The URL or host:path the finding was observed against.

evidence.description: Free-form key/value evidence (request/response dumps, matched patterns, etc.) — matches Go's map[string]string.
